items.title: Class listening — ETS Test
items.subtitle: Lecture · Part 3 conversations · listen and write what you hear

questions.transcript: ETS test. Questions 1 through 3 refer to the following conversation. Good afternoon. I currently subscribe to your Gold Plan satellite television package. I'd like to switch to the Platinum Plan because there are some new movie channels that I'd like to watch. Of course. I'd be happy to help you upgrade your subscription. Could you spell your last name for me so that I can look up your account? Yes, it's K-W-A-N. When should I expect to have access to the extra channels? Your account will reset tomorrow at 6 a.m., so you'll be able to watch them first thing in the morning. I just want to remind you that an extra 15 dollars will appear on your next monthly bill for this expanded service. Number 1. What is the conversation mainly about? Number 2. What does the woman ask for? 3. According to the woman, when will the change take effect?

Questions 4 through 6 refer to the following conversation. Hi, I'm calling to book a train ticket from London to Edinburgh, please. I'd like to leave around 10 o'clock on Tuesday morning. Certainly, sir. I can reserve a seat for you on the train departing for Edinburgh at 10.30. the cheapest fare is £85. OK, I'd like to buy that ticket please. I'd also like to find out whether there's room on the train for passengers to take bicycles. Yes, there is, but it'll cost £3 more to reserve a space for your bike. Where most likely does the woman work? Number 5. Why is the man calling? Number 6. What does the woman say will cost extra?

I got a bill from the electric company in the mail today. It's so expensive. Mine is too. I guess that's because I've been using the air conditioner so much in this hot weather. So have I, but I still don't think I should have been billed this much. Maybe I should call the electric company and find out if the rates have gone up. That's a good idea. They're very responsive by phone. Let me know what they tell you. number 8. Why might the man make a phone call? number 9. What does the woman want the man to do?

Questions 10 through 12 refer to the following conversation. Hello, Jeffrey Heinz speaking. This is Martha Benjamin. I'm calling to let you know I've put my research report in the inter-office mail. You should have it this afternoon. I hope you're still willing to review it for me. Of course. I'll be out of town on business. for the next few days, but I'll take it with me. I also have your request for additional money to continue your research. Thanks very much. Don't worry about the typos. I'll be sending the report to an editor, but please make suggestions about the content. It's only the first draft, and I'm going to make revisions. I'm really looking forward to your feedback. What is the purpose of Martha's call to Jeffrey? What department does Martha most likely work in? Number 12. What does Martha plan to do?

Questions 13 through 15 refer to the following conversation. Hi, this is Stephen Lim. I applied for a receptionist position in Dr. Houston's office two weeks ago. I was wondering if the position had been filled. Hi, Mr. Lim. Well, no. In fact, I was just about to call you because you're one of the applicants we've selected for an interview. Could you come in this week, sometime between Tuesday and Friday? Sure. Wednesday would work best for me. 11.30? Yes, that's okay. Please remember that there won't be anyone at the reception desk, so come straight to Room 12 and ask to speak with Maureen Number 13. What is the purpose of the call? Number 14. For which day has Mr. Lim's appointment been scheduled? Number 15. What is Mr. Lim told to do?

Questions 16 through 18 refer to the following conversation. Excuse me. Do you know where the photocopier is? I just started working here, and there's all this paperwork I have to submit today. The photocopiers are at the end of the hall on the left. You must be Sarah, the new office manager. I'm Ken Davies. I'm the Public Relations Director here. Oh, hi, Ken. Are you the Ken Davies who's speaking at the staff meeting this afternoon? That's me. I'll be giving a presentation on maintaining good relationships with the news media. I guess I'll see you at the meeting then. Number 16. What is the woman about to do? 17. Who is the man? Number 18. What are the speakers planning to do this afternoon?

Questions 19 through 21 refer to the following conversation. Hi, I'm Petra Barlow. I have an interview for a position in the accounting department here at Houseman Incorporated. Hello, Ms. Barlow. Let me check in the computer. While I do that, would you put on this visitor's badge so it's easy to see? Yes, of course. I'm supposed to meet with Helen Wade in meeting room 2B, is that right? Actually, it looks like there was a last-minute change. You'll be meeting in room 12A instead. It's down that hallway and to your left. Thanks a lot. Why is the woman at Houseman Incorporated? What does the man ask the woman to do? Number 21. What does the man say has changed?

This is a great school and I'll hate to leave, but I'd really prefer to teach younger children.
